items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Well what about your father in law, Joe H. Foer

ctx.x: Oh, well they had a lot of guys. I mean it, let me see. Definitely not. Kid Howard, he was a fella I went a while, he made it. Alright. Rika, yep he made it.
Well what about your father in law, Joe H. Foer, did he play with many bands?
Oh yeah, he played, mostly he played with brass bands.
